brief:
Israeli settlers shot and killed a 72-year-old Palestinian woman overnight in Jericho, according to Al-Monitor. The killing occurred in an area where settlers have recently taken control of several Palestinian properties in the occupied West Bank city.

The incident marks another instance of settler violence in the West Bank, where Israeli militant groups have intensified operations in recent months amid broader tensions in the Palestinian territories.

title: Israeli settlers shoot dead elderly Palestinian woman in West Bank
